oral_examination.oral_examination: Large areas of dental calculus on the entire mouth, red and swollen gums, and bleeding on probing

treatment_plan.definitive: It is recommended to treat multiple caries and filling is recommended - multiple deep caries penetrate the pulp and RCT is recommended
treatment_plan.notes: Avoid biting hard food, pay attention to oral hygiene, and return to the clinic regularly. Eat and drink after 2 hours.
